answer_1.quote: We introduce TASTE, a method that aims at improving the translation performance of LLMs... Machine translation ... We evaluate the translation performance on the WMT22 test set ... covering German ⇔ English and Chinese ⇔ English language pairs.

answer_2.quote: We report the BLEU scores by SacreBLEU and COMET scores by wmt22-comet-da.
